name: no-input-zero
description: Input on L0 and L1 stops after 300ms and the trace runs on for another 4.2s, crossing the resolver's 1000ms staleness threshold at tick 14 and the end of the decay window at tick 43. With no_input_behavior = zero, the value snaps to zero the moment the axis goes stale. Frequency (linked to L1) shows the effect directly in the B0 period bytes. Intensity is on the ENGINE path, which holds via the V2 ramp regardless of this setting — no_input_behavior does not reach it, so the intensity bytes are identical across all four of these fixtures by design.
